description: This file serves as the main entry point for the Pygments library's command-line interface, specifically handling execution when invoked with 'python -m pygments'. It primarily imports the 'main' function from the 'cmdline' module within the vendor-provided Pygments package and executes it with command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function imported from 'cmdline' that handles the command-line interface for Pygments.
